name: tres-wallets-upload
description: Upload and onboard multiple on-chain wallets or exchange accounts into Tres Finance. Use this skill whenever the user wants to add wallets, onboard wallets, import wallets, upload wallet addresses, ingest wallets, or connect exchanges into Tres — whether from a file (CSV/Excel) or by typing them manually. This skill guides Claude through the full flow: wallet type selection → input collection → validation → preview with editable HTML table → exchange credential collection (if exchange) → user confirmation → batch creation via the TRES MCP API. Always trigger this skill for wallet onboarding, wallet data ingestion, or any request to "add wallets to Tres".
